settings.image_alt: Taymar Spencer in front of a Pittsburgh mural, wearing Rizo
settings.caption: Taymar Spencer
settings.body:
Rizo didn’t start with money, connections or a plan. It started with Taymar Spencer wanting a real way to express himself, and not letting what he didn’t have decide what he could make.

He learned by making: trying things, rebuilding them, and taking help from people who believed in it. He still draws the designs and makes the clothes himself.

The part that stuck was the people. Seeing someone get a piece, put it on and feel something is still the point.
Rizo started through limitations. I was in a box, and I broke out.
